messages.subject: New priorities
parts: I just wanted to alert people that from now onwards I won't be able to take a stab at every question that pops up here and not in the timely fashion that used to be my goal, due to changing priorities. I thought it necessary to make this announcement to manage expectations in this community (aka, stem the flow of angry messages to my personal address). I am delighted to see that some members have already stepped up to the plate. Cheers
